question: Hitung berapa banyak film pada setiap rating.
generated_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_film FROM film GROUP BY rating;

question: Tampilkan rata-rata durasi film untuk setiap kategori film.
generated_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(f.length) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT cat.name AS category, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length
FROM category AS cat
JOIN film_category AS fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id
JOIN film AS f           ON fc.film_id     = f.film_id
GROUP BY cat.name;

question: Hitung total nilai pembayaran per bulan pada tahun 2006.
generated_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_pembayaran, MONTH(payment_date) AS bulan FROM payment WHERE YEAR(payment_date) = 2006 GROUP BY MONTH(payment_date);
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT MONTH(payment_date) AS bulan, SUM(amount) AS total_pembayaran
FROM payment
WHERE YEAR(payment_date) = 2006
GROUP BY MONTH(payment_date);

question: Tampilkan setiap toko beserta total nilai pembayaran yang diterima sepanjang tahun 2006.
generated_sql: SELECT s.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_pembayaran FROM store s JOIN staff st ON s.manager_staff_id = st.staff_id JOIN rental r ON st.staff_id = r.staff_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id WHERE YEAR(p.payment_date) = 2006 GROUP BY s.store_id;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT s.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_sales_2006
FROM payment AS p
JOIN staff   AS s ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE YEAR(p.payment_date) = 2006
GROUP BY s.store_id;

question: Tampilkan nama aktor dan jumlah film yang mereka bintangi, urutkan dari yang terbanyak.
generated_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS jumlah_film FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY jumlah_film DESC;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM actor AS a
JOIN film_actor AS fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY film_count DESC;

question: Tampilkan film ber-rating 'R' yang dirilis pada 2006 dengan durasi di atas rata-rata durasi semua film 'R' tahun 2006; sertakan judul, tahun rilis, dan durasinya.
generated_sql: SELECT f.title, f.release_year, f.length FROM film f WHERE f.rating = 'R' AND f.release_year = 2006 AND f.length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film WHERE rating = 'R' AND release_year = 2006);
ground_truth_sql: SELECT title, release_year, length FROM film WHERE release_year = 2006 AND rating = 'R' AND length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film WHERE release_year = 2006 AND rating = 'R');

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang jumlah sewanya berada di bawah (rata-rata jumlah sewa per pelanggan minus satu simpangan baku); sertakan nama dan total sewanya.
generated_sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS total_sewa 
FROM customer c 
JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id 
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name 
HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) < (SELECT AVG(total_sewa) - STDDEV(total_sewa) 
                             FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(rental_id) AS total_sewa 
                                   FROM rental 
                                   GROUP BY customer_id) AS subquery);
ground_truth_sql: SELECT sub.first_name, sub.last_name, sub.rental_count FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) AS sub JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, STDDEV(cnt) AS std_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id) AS t) AS stats ON 1=1 WHERE sub.rental_count < stats.avg_cnt - stats.std_cnt;

question: Di antara film 'PG-13', tampilkan yang biaya sewanya lebih tinggi dari rata-rata biaya sewa film 'PG-13' **dengan durasi > 120 menit** di kategori yang sama; sertakan judul, kategori, dan rental_rate.
generated_sql:
SELECT f.title, c.name AS category, f.rental_rate 
FROM film f 
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id 
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id 
WHERE f.rating = 'PG-13' AND f.length > 120 
AND f.rental_rate > (SELECT AVG(rental_rate) 
                     FROM film 
                     WHERE rating = 'PG-13' AND length > 120);
ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.title, cat.name AS category, f.rental_rate FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE f.rating = 'PG-13' AND f.length > 120 AND f.rental_rate > (SELECT AVG(f2.rental_rate) FROM film f2 JOIN film_category fc2 ON f2.film_id=fc2.film_id WHERE fc2.category_id = fc.category_id AND f2.rating='PG-13' AND f2.length > 120);

question: Tampilkan kategori film yang rata-rata durasinya lebih pendek daripada rata-rata durasi semua film; sertakan nama kategori dan rata-rata durasinya.
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, AVG(f.length) AS rata_rata_durasi 
FROM film f 
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id 
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id 
GROUP BY c.name 
HAVING AVG(f.length) < (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film);
ground_truth_sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name HAVING AVG(f.length) < (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film);

question: Tampilkan staf yang jumlah transaksi pembayarannya lebih sedikit daripada rata-rata jumlah transaksi per staf; sertakan nama depan, nama belakang, dan jumlah transaksinya.
generated_sql:
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS jumlah_transaksi 
FROM staff s 
LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id 
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name 
HAVING COUNT(p.payment_id) < (SELECT AVG(jumlah_transaksi) 
                               FROM (SELECT staff_id, COUNT(payment_id) AS jumlah_transaksi 
                                     FROM payment 
                                     GROUP BY staff_id) AS subquery);
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payment_count FROM staff s JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) < (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM payment GROUP BY staff_id) AS sub);

question: Tampilkan nama depan, nama belakang, dan kota tempat tinggal semua pelanggan yang pernah menyewa film dengan kategori animasi pada tahun 2006.
generated_sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city 
FROM customer c 
JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id 
JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id 
JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id 
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id 
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id 
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id 
JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id 
WHERE cat.name = 'Animation' AND YEAR(r.rental_date) = 2006;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city
FROM customer AS c
JOIN address  AS a  ON c.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN city     AS ci ON a.city_id    = ci.city_id
JOIN rental   AS r  ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category AS fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category AS cat     ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
WHERE cat.name = 'Animation' AND YEAR(r.`rental_date`)='2006';

question: Daftar judul film beserta nama bahasa untuk semua film berdurasi lebih dari 184 menit.

ground_truth_sql:

question: Tampilkan nama aktor dan judul film yang dirilis tahun 2006 dengan rating 'PG'. Di mana judul filmnya mengandung kata pilot.

question: Daftar nama depan dan belakang pelanggan beserta tanggal sewanya untuk setiap transaksi dengan pembayaran di atas 11 dolar. Jangan tampilkan baris duplikat.
generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.payment_date FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE p.amount > 11;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name, r.rental_date
FROM customer AS c
JOIN rental  AS r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN payment AS p ON r.rental_id   = p.rental_id
WHERE p.amount > 11;

question: Tampilkan judul film, kategori film, dan nama lengkap penyewanya untuk transaksi pada 16 Agustus 2005.

question: Tampilkan **nama lengkap** (gabungan nama depan dan belakang) aktor serta jumlah filmnya yang membintangi film lebih banyak daripada Matthew Carrey, lalu urutkan dari jumlah film terbanyak.
generated_sql: SELECT CONCAT(a.first_name, ' ', a.last_name) AS nama_lengkap, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS jumlah_film FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name != 'MATTHEW' AND a.last_name != 'CARREY' GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(fa.film_id) > (SELECT COUNT(fa2.film_id) FROM actor a2 JOIN film_actor fa2 ON a2.actor_id = fa2.actor_id WHERE a2.first_name = 'MATTHEW' AND a2.last_name = 'CARREY') ORDER BY jumlah_film DESC;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', a.first_name, a.last_name) AS full_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS number_of_films FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id HAVING COUNT(fa.film_id) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor fa2 JOIN actor a2 ON fa2.actor_id = a2.actor_id WHERE a2.first_name = 'MATTHEW' AND a2.last_name = 'CARREY') ORDER BY number_of_films DESC;

question: Tampilkan bahasa yang tidak memiliki satu pun film berating 'R'.
generated_sql: SELECT l.name FROM language l WHERE l.language_id NOT IN (SELECT f.language_id FROM film f WHERE f.rating = 'R');
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT l.name AS language
FROM language AS l
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM film AS f
    WHERE f.language_id = l.language_id
      AND f.rating = 'R'
);

question: Tampilkan staf yang total nilai pembayarannya melebihi rata-rata total pembayaran per staf; sertakan nama staf dan total pembayarannya.
generated_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_pembayaran FROM staff s JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > (SELECT AVG(total_pembayaran) FROM (SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_pembayaran FROM payment GROUP BY staff_id) AS subquery);
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_sales
FROM staff AS s
JOIN payment AS p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
HAVING SUM(p.amount) > (
    SELECT AVG(total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(amount) AS total
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY staff_id
    ) AS t
);

question: Tampilkan film yang belum pernah disewa oleh pelanggan mana pun.
generated_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id LEFT JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_id IS NULL;
ground_truth_sql:
SELECT title
FROM film
WHERE film_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.film_id
    FROM inventory AS i
    JOIN rental AS r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
);

question: Tampilkan pelanggan dari Indonesia yang pernah menyewa film kategori 'Action' tetapi belum pernah menyewa film kategori 'Animation'; sertakan nama depan dan nama belakang mereka.
generated_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ct ON a.city_id = ct.city_id JOIN country co ON ct.country_id = co.country_id JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id WHERE co.country = 'Indonesia' AND fc.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM category WHERE name = 'Action') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category ca ON fc.category_id = ca.category_id WHERE ca.name = 'Animation');
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer AS c JOIN address AS a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city AS ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country AS co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Indonesia' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND cat.name = 'Action') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND cat.name = 'Animation');

question: Siapa pelanggan dengan total nilai pembayaran terbesar? Sertakan nama depan, nama belakang, dan total pembayarannya.
generated_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_pembayaran FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_pembayaran DESC LIMIT 1;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name,c.last_name,SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.first_name,c.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount)=(SELECT MAX(tp) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS tp FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t);

question: Film apa yang memiliki durasi terlama? Sertakan judul dan durasinya.

ground_truth_sql: SELECT title,length FROM film HAVING length=(SELECT MAX(length) FROM film);

question: Kota mana yang memiliki jumlah pelanggan terbanyak? Sertakan nama kota dan jumlah pelanggannya.
generated_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(cu.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM city c JOIN address a ON c.city_id = a.city_id JOIN customer cu ON a.address_id = cu.address_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC LIMIT 1;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ci.city,COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id=a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id=ci.city_id GROUP BY ci.city HAVING COUNT(*)=(SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer c2 JOIN address a2 ON c2.address_id=a2.address_id JOIN city ci2 ON a2.city_id=ci2.city_id GROUP BY ci2.city) x);

question: Siapa pelanggan yang paling sering menyewa film? Sertakan nama depan, nama belakang, dan jumlah sewanya.
generated_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS total_rentals FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_rentals DESC;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name,c.last_name,COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.first_name,c.last_name HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id) AS t);

question: Pada tahun 2005, bulan apa yang mencatat total pembayaran terbesar? Sertakan nomor bulan (1–12) dan total pembayarannya.
generated_sql: SELECT MONTH(p.payment_date) AS bulan, SUM(p.amount) AS total_pembayaran FROM payment p WHERE YEAR(p.payment_date) = 2005 GROUP BY MONTH(p.payment_date) ORDER BY total_pembayaran DESC LIMIT 1;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT MONTH(payment_date) AS month_num,SUM(amount) AS total_payment FROM payment WHERE YEAR(payment_date)=2005 GROUP BY MONTH(payment_date) HAVING SUM(amount)=(SELECT MAX(tp) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS tp FROM payment WHERE YEAR(payment_date)=2005 GROUP BY MONTH(payment_date)) m);
